item.title: 'Rush For Passes Is Sweet Challenge': PWL CEO Reflects On League Success
item.description: The Pro Wrestling League: The Pro Wrestling League (PWL) CEO Akhil Gupta said the extended gap since the league’s last edition has heightened interest among fans, reflected in strong crowd turnout at the venues.

item.title: WPL 2026: Harmanpreet’s 82 Not Out In Vain As Gujarat Giants Seal Playoffs Spot (Ld)
item.description: But Harmanpreet Kaur: Eight straight defeats to Mumbai Indians and a rivalry that had become their biggest stumbling block – the odds were stacked up against Gujarat Giants when their decisive WPL 2026 clash against Mumbai Indians arrived at the BCA Stadium, Kotambi, on Friday.

item.title: We Have Embedded Soils From Akhadas Of Each Participating States In Trophy: PWL Chair Dayaan Farooqi
item.description: Pro Wrestling League: Explaining the thought and symbolism behind the Pro Wrestling League (PWL) 2026 trophy, chairman Dayaan Farooqi highlighted the work process behind the idea of making it connected to the soil of the country.

item.title: WPL 2026: To Be Going Into The Playoffs With This Group Of Players Is Really Pleasing, Says Gardner
item.description: Skipper Ashleigh Gardner: Gujarat Giants finally broke their eight-match losing streak against Mumbai Indians by registering their first-ever win over the defending champions to book their spot in 2026 WPL playoffs. Skipper Ashleigh Gardner said she was pretty pleased to enter the playoffs with the current bunch of players.

item.title: Mertens and Zhang Reunite to Win Australian Open Women’s Doubles Title
item.description: Elise Mertens and Zhang Shuai reunited after two years to claim the Australian Open women’s doubles crown, defeating Anna Danilina and Aleksandra Krunic in straight sets and adding another Grand Slam title to their partnership.

item.title: Georgia Wareham Stars with Bat and Ball as Gujarat Beat Mumbai Indians in WPL 2026
item.description: Leg-spinner Georgia Wareham delivered a match-winning all-round performance, scoring an unbeaten 44 and taking two wickets as Gujarat Giants defeated Mumbai Indians by 11 runs in a crucial WPL 2026 clash, earning her Player of the Match honors.

item.title: Delhi Pro Volleyball League Set To Debut This Year
item.description: The Delhi Pro Volleyball League: Delhi Pro Volleyball League (DPVL) has been officially launched with backing of the Delhi Volleyball Association, along with support from the Delhi Olympic Association.

item.title: England Beat Sri Lanka by 11 Runs (DLS) in 1st T20I as Sam Curran Claims Hat-Trick
item.description: England underlined their T20 World Cup credentials with an 11-run DLS victory over Sri Lanka in the first T20I at Pallekele, as Sam Curran grabbed a hat-trick and Phil Salt starred with the bat.

item.title: Aus Open: Rafael Nadal Arrives In Melbourne To Take Part In 'Night Of Legends' Event
item.description: Aus Open: The 22-time Grand Slam champion Rafael Nadal has reached the city on Saturday for a special appearance at the Australian Open’s Night of Legends on Sunday, the same day as the men’s singles final between 24-time Grand Slam champion Novak Djokovic and World No. 1 Carlos Alcaraz.

item.title: WPL 2024: Mumbai Indians Lacked Consistency, Poor Start Hurt Campaign, Says Coach Lisa Keightley
item.description: Mumbai Indians head coach Lisa Keightley admitted injuries, frequent changes, and a slow start derailed their WPL campaign after an 11-run loss to Gujarat Giants dented playoff hopes.
